about: Species interactions. Each rule: [actor, target, kind, weight 0-1, what the tap card says, source]. actor/target: a species key, m:<body type> (e.g. m:cera), *pred, *herb or * (any). kinds: hunts (preferred prey, weight raises the pick chance), scavenges (goes to fresh carcasses of target), follows (moves with target), avoids (keeps away from target), rivals (fights target when close).
